primaryChecks.text: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”
primaryChecks.previousContext: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”
primaryChecks.nextContext: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: この節は地域表現を直接述べる。部族・祖先の人物IDとは区別し、本文が明示する範囲以上を推定しない。

wikipediaRead.title: Mount Ephraim
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事は「Mount of Ephraim」を中央山岳地帯の歴史的地域とし、エフライム族に割り当てられた丘陵地を述べる。列王記下の表現と関係する地理説明だが、本文が示さない境界まで確定するものではない。
